label: GO after an unrewarded a2->S2 trial, late in the episode (peak trials 80-89), stronger when S2 is believed good
short_terms: (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * (ep_trial >= 70) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * (ep_dec == 8) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * belief_lo
terms: (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * (ep_dec == 6) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * (ep_dec == 7) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * (ep_dec == 8) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * (ep_dec == 9) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * (ep_trial >= 60) * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * (ep_trial >= 60) * belief_lo ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * (ep_trial >= 60) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * (ep_trial >= 60)
explanation: Fires only at GO and only late in the episode (trials 60+, peak in decile 8). Its magnitude comes almost entirely from the previous trial being a2 -> S2 (common) unrewarded: after other previous-trial patterns it is near zero, even late. Within that cell it is larger when the observer belief leans toward S2 being good (negative belief_lo) and smaller when the trial before was also unrewarded (first loss after a win is strongest). D1 and D2 are always zero. The free fit adds a per-decile episode profile and the two-back reward: test 0.55 vs 0.47 for the short form (86%). Part of the misses come from window-start trials whose previous trial is outside the window, so last_is cannot see it.

issues: The claims hold. The feature is exactly zero at D1 and D2 (both the residual table and the timing baseline are 0). At GO the only previous-trial pattern with a positive residual is a2 S2 u (+0.10; every other pattern is between -0.015 and -0.003).

The belief term is real but adds only a little. Dropping it lowers test R^2 from 0.468 to 0.416. Its weight is -0.037, so the feature is larger when belief leans toward S2. The step form (belief_lo < 0) scores 0.446 and np.abs(belief_lo) scores 0.428, so the signed log-odds is the right shape. The belief-decile residual peaks at deciles 3-4 (mildly S2), not at the extreme.
The claim about the trial two back is only weakly supported. Swapping in (tv('reward',-2)==1) for belief gives a +0.04 weight (larger after a win then a loss) but a lower test score (0.426).
The timing is right. The ep_dec==8 bump term is needed: (ep_trial>=70) plus (ep_trial>=80) gives 0.440, and a linear ep_trial term gives 0.424.

One systematic miss remains, and it involves a future variable. After a2 S2 u, GO steps where the agent then chooses a1 are over-predicted (one worst-fit example predicts 0.46 against an actual 0). So the feature partly tracks the upcoming a2 choice. Using (action==2) in place of belief scores lower (0.429), so the observed-only form is kept.

Firing on the first trial of a window (no previous trial visible, e.g. t85 at 0.91 with a prediction of 0.06) is under-predicted. This is the known window-edge limit of last_is. A window-start term adds nothing (0.416).
